name: chessops
description: Chess and chess variant rules and operations
author: Niklas Fiekas <niklas.fiekas@backscattering.de>

scripts.version: grep -q "^## v$npm_package_version$" CHANGELOG.md || { echo "CHANGELOG.md has no section for v$npm_package_version"; exit 1; } && npm --prefix fuzz install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix examples install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && git add fuzz/package-lock.json examples/package-lock.json
scripts.doc: typedoc src/types.ts src/attacks.ts src/util.ts src/squareSet.ts src/board.ts src/setup.ts src/chess.ts src/compat.ts src/debug.ts src/fen.ts src/san.ts src/transform.ts src/variant.ts src/pgn.ts
